title: Coding workers, slice 1: create a writable worker in a fresh worktree at a resolved base commit
outcome: A parent can spawn one writable coding worker (mode=worker, writePolicy isolatedWorktree) that starts in a fresh dedicated Git worktree created at one resolved base commit, with read-only roles unchanged. Result handoff (diff/commit and test result) is slice 2.
acceptance: Spawning mode=worker with writePolicy isolatedWorktree and an optional base (ref or commit, default HEAD) resolves the base to exactly one commit object ID with safe argument handling (an option-like or ambiguous ref is refused), creates one fresh dedicated worktree at that OID without copying the parent's staged, unstaged or untracked changes, records that OID as the delegation's baseRevision, and starts one writable worker session there through the existing delegation lifecycle; covered by focused tests through the production spawn route.

Unsupported combinations are refused clearly and unchanged: sharedWorktree stays deferred with its existing refusal, and writable worker modes other than isolatedWorktree are rejected with a message naming the supported combination; explorer dirty-state carry and reviewer/evaluator read-only behavior are unchanged, proven by the existing read-only tests still passing and one new test asserting a reviewer spawn is still read-only.

Existing delegation records without a baseRevision still load and display (backward-compatible persistence), covered by a test, and the full five-stage gate passes on the exact final input with an independent review pair having no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
